page.content:
Sun god whose boat crosses sky by day and Duat by night.

How Ra connects

  • Ship: Solar barque — Ra crosses sky and Duat in the solar barque.
  • Location: Duat — Ra travels the Duat each night to be reborn at dawn.
  • Character: Apep — Apep attacks Ra's boat so the sun might fail to rise.
  • Character: Atum — Ra and Atum fuse as the solar creator of Heliopolis.

What is Ra?

Ra is the solar creator who merges with Atum and later Amun. Each night he dies and is reborn in the Duat; the pharaoh claimed descent from his circuit.

Key threads lead to Solar barque, Duat, Apep and Atum.
